preconditions.expression: n == 0 or n < 0 or isinstance(n, int)
preconditions.description: Input n is either zero, negative, or a non-negative integer.

postconditions.description: If n is zero or negative, the function returns an empty string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.split('\n')[i] == ''.join(str(n - j) for j in range(i + 1)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For positive n, each line i (0-based) in the output is a string formed by concatenating integers from n down to n-i, with no spaces.
